Original Star Trek: The Next Generation Customizable Card Game title artwork cropped from Decipher’s November 1994 First Edition rulebook cover. The original game publisher was Decipher.<ref>[https://ericbsmith.no-ip.org/CCGST1E/rules/1eRulebook_v1.0.pdf Original artwork source] (PDF page 1). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107200225/https://ericbsmith.no-ip.org/CCGST1E/rules/1eRulebook_v1.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
